title: iOS 1.9 — Shared trips and observed radar intensity
body:
- Trips can now be shared. Send someone a trip link and they open the whole chain — every leg, and which one is deciding it — then add those flights to their own list in one tap. A trip opens for someone else only when every one of its legs is shared.
- "Open Trip" added to a flight’s menu, so a leg that belongs to a trip is never a dead end.
- Observed radar now says what it means: "heavy echo, peak 44 dBZ" instead of a bare number, with precipitation rate qualified the same way.
- The cross-section's observed radar strip now uses the same intensity steps as a cockpit weather radar, so red and magenta appear where you'd expect them rather than a notch late.
- You can send feedback about a specific briefing from the pack menu — the report arrives with that flight and briefing attached.
